steps: export STAGE_OUT=/work/prod/verify_inputs && mkdir -p "$STAGE_OUT" && { "$PY" "$WORK/verify_inputs.py" data --job-spec "$REPO_DIR/config/r1/jobs/rankrepro.json" --pins "$REPO_DIR/config/r1/input_pins.json" --out "$STAGE_OUT"; }; rc=$?; mkdir -p /work/out/prod && cp -r "$STAGE_OUT" /work/out/prod/; exit $rc

export STAGE_OUT=/work/prod/rank_requests && mkdir -p "$STAGE_OUT" && { "$PY" "$WORK/rk6_requests.py" build --merged /data/ref/r1/merge/candidates_merged.csv --recovered /data/ref/r1/rec --pins "$REPO_DIR/config/r1/recovered_pins.json" --paper-checks "$REPO_DIR/data/cal2026-10r1/inputs/paper_checks" --rk6a-out /data/ref/r1/rk6a --rulings "$REPO_DIR/data/cal2026-10r1/inputs/rulings_p1.json" --out "$STAGE_OUT/in6"; }; rc=$?; mkdir -p /work/out/prod && cp -r "$STAGE_OUT" /work/out/prod/; exit $rc

export STAGE_OUT=/work/prod/rank_m && mkdir -p "$STAGE_OUT" && { mkdir -p "$WORK/tmp/rank_m" && cd "$REPO_DIR" && RK_REPO="$REPO_DIR" RK_IN="$WORK/prod/rank_requests/in6" RK_OUT="$WORK/tmp/rank_m" SAR_SSD_ROOT=/data/openalex_pipeline "$PY" "$WORK/rk6b_rank.py"; for f in ranks_A.csv ranks_own.csv ranks_C.csv flips.csv rk6b_report.json summary.json RESULT.txt; do [ -f "$WORK/tmp/rank_m/$f" ] && cp "$WORK/tmp/rank_m/$f" "$STAGE_OUT/"; done; rm -rf "$WORK/tmp/rank_m"; test -s "$STAGE_OUT/RESULT.txt"; }; rc=$?; mkdir -p /work/out/prod && cp -r "$STAGE_OUT" /work/out/prod/; exit $rc

export STAGE_OUT=/work/prod/rank_gate && mkdir -p "$STAGE_OUT" && { "$PY" "$WORK/rank_r1.py" gate --new "$WORK/prod/rank_m" --ref /data/ref/r1/rk6b --asserts "$REPO_DIR/config/r1/rank_named_asserts.json" --out "$STAGE_OUT"; }; rc=$?; mkdir -p /work/out/prod && cp -r "$STAGE_OUT" /work/out/prod/; exit $rc

export STAGE_OUT=/work/prod/rank_tables && mkdir -p "$STAGE_OUT" && { "$PY" "$WORK/restake_r1.py" m --rk "$WORK/prod/rank_m" --repo "$REPO_DIR" --out "$STAGE_OUT"; }; rc=$?; mkdir -p /work/out/prod && cp -r "$STAGE_OUT" /work/out/prod/; exit $rc
